grounds.note: Schema extension: schemaVersion 2 has no slot for a second ground, so each colorMeta entry carries a `light` sub-object. The 14 team-* tokens are not redeclared in the light block (a crest is a painted object, the same on both grounds) and are marked groundInvariant. data-theme is set before first paint from the reader's choice or the device. srgbApprox is gamut-clamped where the OKLCH value sits just outside sRGB. Source of truth: src/app/globals.css; every pairing on both grounds is measured in src/app/tokens.test.ts.

display.purpose: Barlow Condensed 700, uppercase, 0.95 line-height, 0.005em tracking (the `display` utility). Page titles (PageHeader, text-4xl stepping to text-5xl at sm), section heads (Bank, text-xl to text-2xl), team names on a scoreboard. Never a button label, a form label or a sentence.

figure.purpose: Barlow Condensed 800, 0.85 line-height, tabular lining figures (the `display-figure` utility, via ScoreFigure at text-2xl / 4xl / 6xl / 7xl-8xl). The hero figure: rank, total, live score, clock in a band.

section.purpose: The display face at section-head size (1.5rem): the heading of a Bank.

body.purpose: Space Grotesk, 400 to 700. Every sentence, label, button and name in a list. Tabular figures from body. Caps at 65 to 75ch.

body-small.purpose: Space Grotesk at 0.875rem: leads under a title, field labels (500, ink-soft), button text (700), empty-state sentences.

label.purpose: Space Grotesk 600, 0.75rem, uppercase, 0.06em tracking, ink-soft (the `slot-label` utility). Column heads, statuses, counts and short context lines.

stat.purpose: JetBrains Mono, tabular (the `stat` utility, the only door to the mono face). Figures read down a column. Sets family and figure style only; weight and tracking stay with the caller. Never prose, never a name.

roll-clock.purpose: JetBrains Mono 500 at 5rem, line-height 1, -0.03em: the draft roll's countdown only, read from the far end of a sofa.

motion.name: ease-broadcast
motion.purpose: The one curve (ease-out-quint), --ease-broadcast. Every moment and every board event runs on it.

motion.name: card-lands
motion.purpose: A card landing in its slot: opacity 0 and translateY(-0.375rem) to rest. Guarded for reduced motion inside the utility.

motion.name: rule-advances
motion.purpose: The live rule drawing itself across the slot now on the clock; from the right on data-reversed (even snake rounds). Keyed on data-advanced.

motion.name: pick-springs
motion.value: pick-springs 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; scale 0.86 to 1.04 to 0.99 to 1
motion.purpose: The slot the marker just left springing shut on its pick. Only a slot that filled, only one slot, never on first paint. Keyed on data-landed.

motion.name: slot-drawn
motion.purpose: The roll drawing a draft slot: translateY(0.875rem) and opacity 0 to rest.

motion.name: overtake
motion.value: overtake 700ms var(--ease-broadcast) both, overtake-flash 1400ms ease-out 500ms both
motion.purpose: Moment: your row slides up past the team you passed, then flashes a gain wash. Keyed on league + round + new rank.

motion.name: crown
motion.value: crown-drop 800ms var(--ease-broadcast) both; with sweep: gold-sweep 1100ms var(--ease-broadcast) 350ms both
motion.purpose: Moment: the round winner's crest gets a dropped crown and a gold sweep. Keyed on league + round.

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: Moment: a deal card stamped WINNING / LOSING (verdict-stamp). Keyed on deal + verdict.

motion.name: spoon
motion.purpose: Moment: the round's last place gets a swinging wooden spoon. Keyed on league + round.

motion.name: badge
motion.purpose: Moment: an earned streak badge flips in. Keyed on league + badge + holder.

motion.name: lower-third
motion.value: wipe-in 520ms var(--ease-broadcast) both; body rise-in 520ms var(--ease-broadcast) 260ms both
motion.purpose: Moment: draft night's 'pick is in' wipe across every screen. Keyed on pick number.

motion.name: stat-tick
motion.purpose: A box-score figure the feed just changed: a gain wash that fades, once.

motion.name: on-air-pulse
motion.purpose: The dot beside the word LIVE on the on-air badge. The one looping animation; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: float-in
motion.purpose: Small things opening over the page settle in from 4 to 6px.

motion.name: transition-colors
motion.purpose: Hover and focus colour changes on interactive elements.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): every moment to its end state, every named animation none, transition-duration 0.01ms globally
motion.purpose: Moments play once per viewer (Moment sets data-playing only when this viewer has not seen the id); the server renders the end state, so a reload and reduced motion are both still.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: The app shell's sidebar (on stock-sunk) replaces the phone tab bar; wide measures open to 80rem.

breakpoints.name: 2xl
breakpoints.purpose: The broad measure only: a game's two box scores side by side up to 110rem.

containers.name: broad
containers.purpose: A game's two box scores side by side.

contrastFloors.scope: ink, ink-soft, ink-faint, live, gain, loss, gold, pos-g/f/c and rail on stock, stock-panel, stock-high and stock-sunk, on both grounds
rule and rule-strong on every surface, both grounds; rule-strong heavier than rule
live-ink on live (the primary action's label); on-air-ink on on-air (the LIVE word)
live at 80% as a border on stock
ink, ink-soft, ink-faint and live on live-sunk; live-sunk a visible step off stock (> 1.1:1)
position letters on their own 10% wash; ink and ink-soft on a position slot over stock and panel; rule-strong on a position slot
team crest monogram ink on every team colour
both grounds declare every measured token exactly once and their own color-scheme

components.name: Primary action
components.description: SubmitButton tone="live": the one filled accent on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-live { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-live); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-live); color: var(--color-live-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms; } .ds-btn-live:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-live:active { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-live:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-live); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-live:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: SubmitButton tone="ink": outlined, everything that is not the one act.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-btn-ink:active { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ink) 5%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-live); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ink:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A boxed field on stock; label in Space Grotesk 500 ink-soft above it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-input { min-height: 2.75rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-stock); color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-faint); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-live); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-live) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Filter pill
components.description: A pressed pill fills with ink; an unpressed one is ruled.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; min-width: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-soft); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-soft); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-pill[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-stock); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-live); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Framed panel
components.description: Level 1 of the depth scale: groups a task. Display-face heading. Never a panel inside a panel.
components.html:
Your roster

Thirteen places, five guards, five forwards, three centers.
components.css: .ds-bank { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-panel-border); border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--color-stock-panel); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-bank-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.005em; line-height: 0.95; font-size: 1.5rem; } .ds-bank-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-ink-soft); }

components.name: Card block
components.description: One subject: filled on panel stock, live in a 2px accent border on the accent field, waiting dashed and unfilled.
components.html:
Filled
On the clock
Open place
components.css: .ds-block { padding: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-panel-border); border-radius: 0.625rem; background: var(--color-stock-panel); color: var(--color-ink); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-block-live { padding: calc(0.75rem - 1px); border: 2px solid var(--color-live); background: var(--color-live-sunk); } .ds-block-waiting { border: 1px dashed var(--color-rule); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-faint); }

components.name: Board slots
components.refersTo: Slot (slot-waiting / slot-filled / slot-live / slot-standing / slot-correction / slot-transit)
components.description: The state language in the row's own ruling: dashed is unsettled, solid is settled, the 2px accent is who is on the clock.
components.html:
1. 1 · Filled
  2. 2 · On the clock
  3. 3 · Waiting
  4. 4 · Paused
components.css: .ds-slots { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-slot { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-slot-filled { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); } .ds-slot-live { border-top: 2px solid var(--color-live); background: var(--color-live-sunk); } .ds-slot-waiting { border-top: 1px dashed var(--color-rule); } .ds-slot-standing { border-top: 2px dashed var(--color-live); }

components.name: Status badge
components.description: A state with its word printed on it: OUT, DOUBTFUL, LIVE (on-air with a pulsing dot), FINAL, PROVISIONAL (dashed), SCHEDULED.
components.html: Live Out Provisional Final
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-live { background: var(--color-on-air); color: var(--color-on-air-ink); } .ds-badge-out { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-loss) 15%, transparent); color: var(--color-loss); } .ds-badge-provisional { border: 1px dashed var(--color-rule-strong); color: var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-badge-final { background: var(--color-stock-high); color: var(--color-ink-soft); } .ds-dot { width: 0.45rem; height: 0.45rem; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; animation: ds-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Position patch
components.description: The letter always printed; an opaque 10% tint mixed into stock, never an alpha wash.
components.html: G F C
components.css: .ds-patch { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-patch-g { color: var(--color-pos-g); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-pos-g) 80%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-pos-g) 10%, var(--color-stock)); } .ds-patch-f { color: var(--color-pos-f); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-pos-f) 80%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-pos-f) 10%, var(--color-stock)); } .ds-patch-c { color: var(--color-pos-c); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-pos-c) 80%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-pos-c) 10%, var(--color-stock)); }

components.name: Team field with crest and score
components.description: A member's colour fading into the panel, the crest monogram beside the team name, the hero figure in the display face.
components.html: WKWaffle Kings412
components.css: .ds-teamfield { --team: var(--color-team-ember); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-ink); background-image: linear-gradient(100deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--team) 34%, var(--color-stock)) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--team) 12%, var(--color-stock-panel)) 58%, var(--color-stock-panel) 100%); } .ds-crest { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--team); color: var(--color-team-ink-dark); font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.05rem; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.175rem color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-team-ink-dark) 35%, transparent); } .ds-teamname { flex: 1; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 0.95; } .ds-figure { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 3.75rem; line-height: 0.85; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; }

narrative.northStar: A matchnight broadcast for one friends' EuroLeague draft league.
narrative.overview: Friends on a couch at 20:00 CET with the game on the TV, phones in hand; a quick check on the way to work the morning after. The app reads like the scoreboard graphic in the same room: dense where density is honest, calm until something happens, and loud for a moment when something does. Restrained neutrals with one accent, Tip-off orange, plus a full palette of team colours that carry identity, on two grounds (dark default, light) solved against the same floors. The contract is ADR-0011 and DESIGN.md; src/app/globals.css is the source of truth for every rendered value.
keyCharacteristics: Lead with the answer: each page's most important fact is its hero, at scoreboard size, on first load at 390px.
Teams are people: a member's crest (colour, shape, monogram) sits beside their team name everywhere the name appears.
Celebrate changes, not pages: a moment plays when something changed that this viewer has not seen, then holds still.
Colour has a word: no state, position or identity is carried by colour alone.
Server truth, provisional honesty: live figures say provisional and when they were checked.

rules.name: The one act
rules.body: A surface has at most one filled accent button. Everything else is secondary (outlined) or quiet (text).

rules.name: Opaque patches
rules.body: A position patch mixes its tint into stock rather than using an alpha wash, so its letter reads the same on any row.

rules.name: Atmosphere is named
rules.body: Gradients and textures exist only as utilities: team-field, lattice, hardwood, waffle-mark. Never a one-off gradient, glow or glass blur in a component.

rules.name: No side stripes
rules.body: A coloured border-left on a card or row is refused; use the crest, a badge or a patch.

rules.name: Display is not a label
rules.body: Display type is never a button label, a form label or a sentence. Headlines step 1.25x or more above the next level; body copy caps at 65 to 75ch.

rules.name: Never a panel inside a panel
rules.body: bank-framed groups a task; card-block groups a subject. Both are level 1; nothing floats, there is no shadow token.

rules.name: One curve, end state under reduced motion
rules.body: Every moment runs on --ease-broadcast and plays once per viewer; under prefers-reduced-motion every moment is its end state.

dos: Print the word beside every colour.
Put the crest beside every team name.
Keep one filled accent per surface.
Measure every new colour pair in both grounds.
donts: Don't put a form above a page's content.
Don't use display type for labels.
Don't add a gradient outside the named utilities.
Don't use a coloured side stripe.
Don't call anything final before the finished-game pipeline says so.
